prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” agency — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget and whether you need SEO, paid media, content, social, creative, analytics, enterprise-level services, etc.

Quick questions so I can recommend the best fit:
- What are your primary goals? (lead gen, ecommerce revenue, brand awareness, app installs, etc.)
- Which services do you need most? (SEO, PPC, social ads, content, email, CRO, analytics)
- What’s your monthly or project budget range?
- Company stage/size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; B2B or B2C?)
- Any preference for a boutique agency vs larger/full-service firm? Local-only or remote OK?
- Timeline or key milestones?

If you want, I can also give a short vetted shortlist of San Francisco agencies matched to your answers (with specialty, typical budgets, and past client examples). Which would you prefer?
